title: Displays
appliedConfirm: Applied. Keep it or it reverts on its own.
keepQuestion: Keep these display settings? Reverting in %1 s
mapHint: Drag to arrange; monitors snap to each other's edges. Double-click sets the primary.
laptopHint: Uses Omarchy's laptop switch, applied right away; it turns back on when the last external monitor is unplugged
lastScreen: At least one monitor has to stay on
primaryHint: Sits at 0×0 and takes focus when the session starts
customHint: Width×Height@Hz outside the monitor's list (e.g. a 75 Hz overclock)
freeScale: Any value; rounded to one Hyprland accepts
vrrHint: Always can flicker on some panels; Fullscreen is the safe pick for games
vrrInactive: This monitor does not report VRR as active; it may not support it
footer: GDK_SCALE will be %1 (X11 apps pick it up when restarted). Changes revert after %2 s unless kept. Enter applies/keeps, h/l switches monitor, u reverts.
